Electromagnetic waves are waves that can travel through a vacuum and do not require a physical medium.

questions.question: Two people are standing on opposite sides of a wall, and one person is clapping their hands. The other person is able to hear the clapping. What is the most likely explanation for how the sound wave was able to travel through the wall?

options.text: The sound wave was able to travel through the air
options.explanation: The sound wave was not able to travel through the air because the people are on opposite sides of the wall.

options.text: The sound wave was able to travel through the wall itself
options.explanation: Sound waves are able to travel through solid objects, such as walls, by causing the particles of the object to vibrate, allowing the sound wave to propagate through the object.

options.text: The sound wave was reflected off a nearby surface
options.explanation: The sound wave was not reflected off a nearby surface because the people are on opposite sides of the wall.

options.text: The sound wave was diffracted around the wall
options.explanation: The sound wave was not diffracted around the wall because the people are on opposite sides of the wall.
